# FireLink — Fire Safety Equipment, Services & Compliance Platform for India

> FireLink is an India-focused fire and safety platform where organisations buy ISI/BIS-certified
> fire safety equipment from platform-verified vendors, book professional fire safety services
> (inspection, refilling, installation, testing, fire audit, annual maintenance contracts), and
> track every asset, certificate and Fire NOC with QR codes, expiry alerts and a compliance
> calendar. FireLink is designed and built by BrightLoop Technology.

Canonical site: https://firelinkpo.base44.app/
Languages: English (en-IN), Hindi (hi-IN)
Coverage: All of India — PAN-India delivery of equipment and PAN-India service coverage
Contact: /contact — enquiries answered within one working day, Monday to Saturday

## Main pages
- Home: /
- Fire safety products (marketplace): /products
- Fire safety services: /services

## Product categories
Fire extinguishers (ABC dry powder, CO2, clean agent, water, foam, wet chemical); fire detectors
and alarm systems; sprinklers; hose and reels; fire pumps; fire safety signage; personal
protective equipment (PPE). Listings show price, MRP, stock, MOQ, HSN code, applicable standards,
country of origin and manufacturer warranty; B2B and B2C pricing is shown where the vendor
publishes both.

## Services
Inspection and testing; extinguisher refilling and hydro testing; installation and commissioning;
fire alarm and hydrant system maintenance; fire audit and NOC documentation support; annual
maintenance contracts (AMC); on-site technician visits with service reports.

## Compliance knowledge (short answers)
- Fire NOC: issued by the local fire authority and required for most commercial, industrial and
  high-rise buildings before occupancy; renewed periodically, commonly every three to five years
  depending on the authority. FireLink tracks the NOC, its expiry and renewal reminders per site.
- Extinguisher refilling: per IS 15683, refill after every use and otherwise at least annually;
  monthly visual check, annual maintenance visit, hydrostatic testing typically every five years.
- Choosing an extinguisher: 4–6 kg ABC dry powder for homes and offices; CO2 or clean agent for
  electrical/server rooms; wet chemical (Class F) for kitchens.
- AMC: scheduled preventive visits, inspection and testing of extinguishers, hydrants, alarms and
  pumps, refilling or replacement where needed, and a service report after each visit.
- Verification: certificates and assets registered on FireLink carry a QR code that opens a public
  verification page showing the certificate number, issuing authority, issue/expiry dates and status.

## Audience
Organisations (factories, warehouses, hospitals, schools, hotels, offices, data centres, housing
societies), vendors and manufacturers, fire safety engineers, technicians and consultants.

## Not indexed
Signed-in portals (customer, vendor, organisation admin, technician, engineering, platform admin),
cart, checkout and the login/registration flows are private and excluded from search indexing.
